threshold_pre_registered.rationale: 10pp improvement would bring accuracy from 59% to 69% — approaching buyer-grade. Less than 10pp is not materially different.

part_1_territory_1.verdict: NOT MEANINGFUL — mechanism space may be exhausted

hydrodynamic_retention.mechanism: Flow geometry creates low-velocity settling zone where therapeutic accumulates by sedimentation
hydrodynamic_retention.same_problem: YES — retains therapeutic while CSF drains through separate path
hydrodynamic_retention.architecturally_distinct: YES — uses FLOW PHYSICS not SIZE SELECTIVITY or CHEMICAL AFFINITY
hydrodynamic_retention.credible_for_eShunt: YES — eShunt geometry could create settling zone
hydrodynamic_retention.risk: MEDIUM — requires density difference between therapeutic and CSF; may not work for dissolved drugs

same_coupled_problem_test.axis_1_objective: match — both retain therapeutic in CSF
same_coupled_problem_test.axis_2_mechanism: mismatch — hydrodynamic sedimentation vs size filtration
same_coupled_problem_test.axis_6_failure_mode: mismatch — flow disruption vs pore fouling

temperature_responsive.mechanism: Thermoresponsive polymer (e.g., PNIPAM) contracts at 37°C to trap therapeutic, expands when cooled
temperature_responsive.same_problem: YES — retains at body temp, releases on demand
temperature_responsive.credible_for_eShunt: PARTIAL — requires temperature control (may not be practical in vivo)
temperature_responsive.risk: HIGH — body temperature is constant; no release mechanism without external cooling

osmotic_retention.mechanism: Osmotic pressure differential across semi-permeable membrane retains therapeutic
osmotic_retention.same_problem: PARTIAL — osmotic retention requires concentration gradient
osmotic_retention.credible_for_eShunt: PARTIAL — CSF has fixed osmolarity; gradient may not persist
osmotic_retention.risk: HIGH — osmotic gradient depletes over time

mechanical_valve_retention.mechanism: Mechanical valve/flap retains therapeutic in reservoir, opens for CSF drainage
mechanical_valve_retention.same_problem: YES — retains therapeutic mechanically while allowing CSF passage
mechanical_valve_retention.architecturally_distinct: YES — mechanical barrier vs size filtration
mechanical_valve_retention.risk: MEDIUM — valve failure; mechanical wear; may obstruct

verdicts.#1: NOT MEANINGFUL — mechanism space may be exhausted
verdicts.#2: Hydrodynamic retention and mechanical valve are credible alternatives. Hydrodynamic has lower initial retention but slower degradation. Size-selective filter still has best retention durability.
